fusions.name: Out of the Blue
fusions.desc: You dive at an enemy up to 7 tiles away, rushing to it and biting for 12 damage, up to 1.8 times as much from full range.

fusions.name: Feeding Frenzy
fusions.desc: Lunges into every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 25 damage to each. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Skyward Leap
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and you gain +8% dodge chance.

fusions.name: Rested Stoop
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 12 seconds.
